scope: Ten additional trek-experience photos only. Existing Base Camp images are unchanged and not covered by this manifest.
purpose: Show everyday trekking, villages, bridges, lodge rooms and rest stops on the Nepal Everest Base Camp journey.
usage_notes: These are along the trek, not photographs taken at Base Camp itself.
Historical photographs: infrastructure, rooms, businesses and trail conditions may have changed.
Display the supplied creator/source/license credits when publishing. CC BY-SA images retain their respective share-alike licenses.
No image was upscaled beyond its original dimensions. Most available renditions are 1280 pixels wide; the portrait bridge photo is limited to 1600 pixels high.
Namche-area trail photo shows the broader trekking/acclimatization experience, not a promised exact itinerary segment.
